newsitem.title: USA: ContiFinancial names chief financial officer.
newsitem.headline: ContiFinancial names chief financial officer.

text.p: ContiFinancial Corp said on Monday it named Daniel Willett senior vice president and chief financial officer.
Willett, who since 1990 has been vice president and treasurer of Continental Grain Co, the parent of ContiFinancial, will assume his new post on February 1, it said.

ContiFinancial said Willett will be responsible for managing the accounting, finance, treasury, tax, audit and hedging functions while Jerome Perelson, senior vice president, will continue to manage the credit and investor relations activities.
ContiFinancial is a consumer and commercial finance company.
